title: SEO Architecture for Automation Sites: Categories, Internal Links, and Crawl Signals
description: A technical walkthrough for structuring an automation-focused publication so search engines can understand categories, recency, and authority.
excerpt: Good SEO architecture is usually visible in navigation, archives, and metadata before it is visible in rankings. This guide shows the structure MyAppAI uses.
author: MyAppAI Editorial
